'''Lotka Muddoll''' is an [[orc]] quest giver located in [[Moonhoof Village]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]].

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Horde|56|Bound in Stone}} {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Do not listen to that foolish Uz'tuk. He favors the air elementals. Hmph. A weakling who used to cower in the sand. Yet he is strong in a fight, even when lurking in the shadows. He may be the best companion I have had since joining the Earthen Ring. Apart from Muddoll, of course.

Behold, a true elemental. The earth shakes as it moves. The stone breaks in its wake. Truly the embodiment of the orcish desire for both strength and honor. No element is more sturdy, more beautiful, than the very earth you walk on.

<Lotka clears her throat.>

I may have gotten carried away there. You saw nothing.
